name: EH3D-NODE-PNP-HEAD
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF firmware for the ESP32-S3 (not written yet)
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host -C Debug
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: the node of the head of a pick-and-place machine. It runs the vacuum pump and the valve of each nozzle with a pressure sensor or a vacuum switch, the puff of air that lets a part go, the Z axis and the rotation of each nozzle and two lights, under interlocks, tells the machine when every nozzle is raised so that it may move in X and Y, and goes to a safe state by itself when it loses the server. The rules are in the host-tested core and are tried against a simulator of the head; the ESP-IDF firmware is not written, and nothing has been connected to a pump, a valve, a sensor or a motor.
